episodes.title: Nov 2019 haze event
episodes.note: Haze event during the 2019 Kandy measurement campaign. North-easterly inflow carried a high regional background over a calm, shallow boundary layer. Reconstructed basin mean ~44, city centre ~45 ug/m3.
episodes.source: Senarathna et al. 2024; AGU conference record

episodes.title: Dec 2022 nationwide haze
episodes.note: Air quality advisories were issued island-wide (AQI 150-200). North-east monsoon inflow with night-time stagnation. Reconstructed basin mean ~56, city centre ~57 ug/m3.

episodes.title: Feb-Mar 2023 inter-monsoon haze
episodes.note: Stable inter-monsoon conditions with reduced dispersion, noted in a CEA advisory. Reconstructed basin mean ~35, city centre ~37 ug/m3.
